chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Rabi' ibn Abdullah ibn Al-Jaroud Al-Hudhali, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yassar, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no gathering in which the righteous and the immoral gather and they remain upon the remembrance of other than Allah, Mighty and Majestic, except that it will be a regret upon them on the Day of Judgment.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for a gathering where people remember God but not correctly?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) warns that any gathering where both the righteous and the sinful remain engaged in the remembrance of God (other than Allah) will result in regret for its participants on the Day of Judgment. This highlights the importance of sincere and correct dhikr in social and religious assemblies.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Rabi’e Bin Abdullah Bin Al Jaroud Al Huzliy, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from a gathering in which the righteous and the immoral gather and they are persisting upon the Mention of other than Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, except that is would be a regret upon them on the Day of Judgment’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Rib’I ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Jarud al-Hudhalli from al-Fudayl ibnYasar who has said the following: “

Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘If any gathering attended by virtuous and non-virtuous people disperses without mentioning the name of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, it (gathering) will become a regret for them on the Day of Judgment.’”
